review_candidates.title: Supply Chain Manager
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Responsibilities: Develop and lead the Supply Chain Division’s vision, strategy, operating model, objectives, policies, and performance standards in alignment with the company’s operational and growth plans. Work closely with Production, Projects, Engineering, Field Operations, Finance, and Quality Assurance to align material requirements, inspections, purchasing approvals, supplier payments, cost allocation, and delivery priorities. Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management,
eligibility_evidence: Oversee the complete procurement cycle, including supplier sourcing and qualification, quotation evaluation, commercial negotiations, purchase orders, delivery follow-up, and supplier performance, while developing a reliable local and international supplier base.
Manage shipping, freight, customs documentation, clearance, landed-cost analysis, and import compliance.
Direct exposure to senior management and involvement in strategic procurement, international sourcing, factory development, and company-wide operational improvement.
